description_en: Modifies the information of an Android instance. Currently, this operation can be used to modify only the instance name and the upstream and downstream bandwidth limits
description_zh: 修改云手机实例信息，目前仅支持修改实例名称、上下行带宽限制
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic modify-android-instance --android-instance-id acp-8v5bjld0r7tkl0000 --new-android-instance-name new_name --instance-ids acp-5hh4a31emkt6u0000 --up-bandwidth-limit 50 --down-bandwidth-limit 50 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAndroidInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of a single instance. If you specify this parameter, InstanceIds is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 单个实例ID，当该字段有值时会忽略InstanceIds（多个实例ID）
parameters.name: android_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name for the instance.

The name can be up to 30 characters long. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http\:// or https\://. The name can contain only letters, digits, Chinese characters, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
实例的新名称。


实例名称长度不超过30个字符；请以大/小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头，仅支持中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: new_android_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The list of Android instance IDs. You can specify from 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例ID列表，可设置 1~100 个
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The limit for upstream bandwidth. Unit: Mbps
parameters.name: up_bandwidth_limit

parameters.help_en: The limit for downstream bandwidth. Unit: Mbps
parameters.name: down_bandwidth_limit
